texts: Sandcastle ships with built-in providers for Docker, Podman, and Vercel, but you can create your own. A sandbox provider tells Sandcastle how to execute commands in an isolated environment. There are two kinds:
— the sandbox can mount a host directory. Sandcastle creates a worktree on the host and the provider mounts it in. No file sync needed. Use this for Docker, Podman, or any local container runtime.
— the sandbox has its own filesystem (e.g. a cloud VM). The provider handles syncing code in and out via
. Use this when the sandbox cannot access the host filesystem.
